svg.title: 06 / The face comes apart
svg.desc: Original collage layout influenced by Tony Oursler’s projected facial fragments and by parsing-19. Found photographs by Julia Margaret Cameron, Nadar and Dorothea Lange. Drag facial fragments; arrow keys move the focused fragment; Escape restores the composition. This artwork does not run face recognition.
